assets.title: Twin-Rim Paddle Water Wheel
assets.description: Original static water wheel with two thick open timber rims, eight radial spokes per side, a broad solid hub and a Y-axis shaft. Sixteen broad radial paddle boards span the wheel width and seat into both rims, giving visible water-receiving faces. Two outboard A-frame stands support closed annular bearing sleeves; each has a real central bore with a small fixed seated shaft overlap. Two broad flat feet and low cross-ties form one connected grounded assembly. Real spoke apertures, wheel-to-frame side clearance and raised paddle bottom. Four solid PBR materials, separately named closed editable meshes, source Z up, metres and ground-centre origin. One reusable prop including necessary supports. Distinct water-receiving geometry, not a recolored spinning wheel; no mill building, water channel, belt, generator, external textures or third-party marks. One checked static pose only: no rotation, water flow, hydrodynamics, energy generation, transmission, bearing function, loading, engineering or safety certification.
